comparisons.peer_summary: Adjustments to the allowance for unfunded lending commitments are recorded as the Provision for credit losses on unfunded lending commitments.
comparisons.comparison: Both BAC and C disclose that they use the same models and methodologies to estimate Expected Credit Losses (ECL) or credit loss allowances for unfunded lending commitments as they do for funded exposures. BAC explicitly states this in Note 1, while C identifies the specific P&L line item where adjustments to this unfunded allowance are recorded, confirming the existence of the same reserve mechanism.

sentences.text: Reserves are estimated for the unfunded exposure using the same models and methodologies as the funded exposure and are reported as reserves for unfunded lending commitments.
Changes to the allowance for unfunded lending commitments are recorded in Provision for credit losses on unfunded lending commitments.

comparisons.peer_summary: The Firm records a liability and related expense for credit exposure from funding commitments, with the liability in Other liabilities and accrued expenses and the expense in Provision for credit losses.
comparisons.comparison: Both BAC and MS disclose the accounting treatment for credit exposure related to funding/lending commitments. BAC reports specific reserves for these unfunded commitments using ECL models, while MS records a corresponding liability and expense in the Provision for credit losses for the same type of exposure, aligning with the concept of recognizing ECL on unfunded commitments.

sentences.text: In addition to the allowance for loan and lease losses, the Corporation also estimates ECL related to unfunded lending commitments such as letters of credit, financial guarantees, unfunded bankers acceptances and binding loan commitments, excluding commitments accounted for under the fair value option.
The Firm records the liability and related expense for the credit exposure related to commitments to fund loans.
The liability is recorded in Other liabilities and accrued expenses in the balance sheet and the expense is recorded in the Provision for credit losses in the income statement.
